unit: weights: the simulator's DPS per point (tanks: threat per second per point; dtps_weights: damage taken per second per point), means as the run printed them; se: one standard error, weights_stdev / sqrt(sample_counts), same unit

study.what: per key: seeds 1-N (run.sim_seed, disjoint iterations). calibration = the spread (standard deviation) of each stat's mean over the seeds over the mean of its reported standard errors (1 = the reported error is the right size); correlation = the stats' estimates over the seeds, standardized, pairwise; swaps = each slot's pre-BiS item against its BiS item (simulator item stats, no enchants): the spread of the score change over the seeds against the independent-errors prediction sqrt(sum (dx * se)^2)

swap_noise_all.what: per ML entry: its pre-BiS -> BiS slot swaps (simulator item stats, no enchants), one standard error of the score change (independent stats, the full pass's errors) and the gain, in percent of the BiS set's item score; within_2_errors: swaps whose gain is inside two errors
